title: UI Component and State Design From a Mock
description: Turn a support-inbox mock into clear component boundaries, URL and server state, local drafts, optimistic mutations, responsive behavior, and accessible focus.

sections.title: Data model for URL, server, draft, and mutation state
Interface contracts for components and services
Optimizations for recovery, performance, and accessibility

seo.title: UI Component and State Design From a Mock
seo.description: Turn a support-inbox mock into component boundaries, URL and server state, local drafts, optimistic updates, responsive behavior, and accessible focus.

premiumPreview.summary: Turn a customer-support inbox mock into component boundaries and explicit URL, server, draft, mutation, and responsive view state.
learningOutcomes: Derive product questions and responsive behavior from incomplete visual evidence.
Separate shareable URL state, versioned server entities, ticket drafts, and optimistic command overlays.
Preserve an unsent reply while background updates and failed mutations reconcile.
Restore meaningful focus as the workspace moves between desktop panes and mobile routes.
premiumPreview.unlockDescription: Premium unlocks the full architecture walkthrough, evaluation rubric, trade-offs, and failure-mode analysis.

editorial.primaryKeyword: UI component and state design from a mock
editorial.searchIntent: Learn how to translate a concrete UI mock into component boundaries and an explicit frontend state model.
editorial.readerPromise: The reader can derive component boundaries, classify state, reconcile background data, preserve drafts, and design responsive focus behavior from a mock.
editorial.uniqueAngle: Use a realistic support inbox where URL selection, cached tickets, composer drafts, background updates, and optimistic commands evolve independently.

companyEvidence.sourceTitle: Intuit SDE2 frontend interview, Bangalore, October 2021 (LeetCode Discuss)

sources.label: LeetCode Discuss: Intuit SDE2 frontend interview, Bangalore, October 2021
sources.note: One SDE2 account describes a craft demo built from a rough design document shared the day before, then extended live with new features. Deriving components and state from a mock practises that first step; it is not the reported app.

sources.label: LeetCode Discuss: Intuit SE2 frontend interview experience, October 2023
sources.note: One SE2 account describes a week-long craft task, an event management system presented with slides and code, where the panel asked for an error fallback page and tests that check real conditions.
